PhoneSignal.title: PhoneSignal
PhoneSignal.description: Anonymized real-time phone GPS ping broadcast along the bus route. Strictly contains NO names, personal identities, or device hardware models.

anonymousId.description: Hashed anonymous identifier for the transmitting device (e.g. anon_a1b2c3d4).

latitude.description: Geographic latitude of the device ping

longitude.description: Geographic longitude of the device ping

waitingTimeSeconds.description: Dwell time in seconds spent stopped near a bus stop

distanceFromRouteMeters.description: Perpendicular distance in meters from designated transit corridor centerline

directionDiffDeg.description: Angular delta between phone movement vector and route road direction

isNearStop.description: Whether device is within 50m of a scheduled transit stop

isGroupedWithBus.description: Whether device is clustered with the bus vehicle

timestamp.description: Unix millisecond timestamp of signal transmission

HealthCheck.title: HealthCheck
HealthCheck.description: Connection test document to verify Firestore availability on boot.

/test/{testId}.description: Connection validation document tested on boot.

/phone_signals/{signalId}.description: Ephemeral crowdsourced transit signals, automatically cleaned up when older than 10 minutes.
